digest.component_or_area: agent tooling workflow and symbol reference resolution
propositions: Agents prefer grep for source-code reference enumeration despite documentation advising Serena, due to zero-cost availability versus deferred symbol tool loading
Serena's LSP-based symbol tools cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib patterns), making grep necessary in those cases
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits and may report stale line numbers, while grep operates on the current tree
The guidance stating 'prefer symbol tools' is ineffective because it is static documentation that decays in salience during multi-turn work and carries no runtime trigger or feedback

Making the rule correct and the preferred path cheap requires a PreToolUse hook on Bash that surfaces a reminder on grep invocations, a project-scoped coaching criterion for incomplete symbol enumeration, deferred tool loading elimination, and corrected documentation encoding the division of labour
